annotation.bound_parties_text: The policy paper proposes non-statutory principles to be interpreted by regulators and states they will not necessarily translate into mandatory obligations, so it binds no one directly.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: These principles provide clear steers for regulators, but will not necessarily translate into mandatory obligations.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Establishing a pro-innovation approach to regulating AI ... Presented to Parliament ... Laid on Monday 18 July 2022.
